Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Harish Srivastava. I am a 53-year-old government clerk living in Pune. M/s Crescent Traders gave me a cheque for 28.4 lakh rupees to repay a loan, but the cheque came back with the remark account closed. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 87694 21184 or email harish.srivastava@example.in.
